# Test Archives for GoUnRAR

Generated by `scripts/gen_test_archives.sh` using RAR 7.20.

Re-run that script to regenerate. **Do not edit these files by hand.**

## Archives

| File | Format | Notes |
|------|--------|-------|
| `single_rar5.rar` | RAR5 | Two text files + one nested in `subdir/` |
| `multi_new.part01-10.rar` | RAR5 multi-volume | 8 KiB of random data split into 1 KiB volumes |
| `password_rar5.rar` | RAR5 | Password: `testpass` |
| `encrypted_header.rar` | RAR5 | Header-encrypted, password: `testpass` |
| `corrupt.rar` | RAR5 (damaged) | Bytes overwritten at offset 20 |
| `with_dirs.rar` | RAR5 | Contains directory entries |

## Limitations

RAR 7.x removed `-ma4` so RAR4 (v3 compression) archives cannot be generated.
If RAR4 test fixtures are needed, generate them with an older `rar` binary and
commit manually.
